## Workload

During the quarter, grader Marcus Bell completed 231 reads. The recorded workload was 112 hours, giving an average of 2.1 reads per hour. This provides a summary of the volume of work completed and the time recorded for the activity. The workload figures are presented together to support consideration of the relationship between the number of reads and the hours worked.

## Quality

A sample of 22 reads was checked as part of the quality review. The recorded agreement was 59.1 per cent. These results provide the basis for the quality assessment documented for the quarter.

The review was completed by Priya Anand. The workload and quality information should be considered together when reviewing the grader’s performance for this period.
